legacy_cells.FN: Reported results (source excerpt): We underline the wide use of deep learning based synthetic data generators in 72.6 % of the included studies, with 75.3 % of the generators being implemented in Python.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M9 Safety & governance; M10 Clinician interface & lifecycle
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Carry the paper’s governance and evaluation considerations into a separate safety/lifecycle service; they do not validate a dynamics model.
legacy_cells.FU: Reviewer mapping (KB §20): Prospective evaluation & lifecycle governance
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted PDF text (PDF pp. 1–20; journal pp. 2892–2910): title/abstract and introduction (pp. 1–2); methods (pp. 3–4); results and Tables 1–7 (pp. 4–13); discussion and conclusion/future directions (pp. 13–16); references and final article page (pp. 16–20). Reviewed the methods/results and tables for reported model implementation and limitations relevant to world-model screening. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: Classified as survey/background because it reviews healthcare synthetic-data methods across modalities, including time-series data; it is not a demonstrated world-model implementation or evaluation. M is inapplicable because the record is included. A:I are preserved. Paper text was readable; no extraction issue noted. Evidence QA: 1/2 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (50%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 1 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 1 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: Survey only; cited model results not independently replicated.
PRISMA prose124/82 conflicts with figure125/83; imaging30 vs31.
Survey percentages are descriptive, not predictive/patient outcomes.
Fidelity does not guarantee privacy despite stronger anonymity rhetoric elsewhere.
Repository accessibility/licenses not independently verified; no independent human entailment review.
notes: All20 pages incl refs17–19 and publisher summary20 read. All4 figures and7 tables incl continuations visually inspected. Appended graphical abstract is blank placeholder ga1. No R0 assigned automatically to survey.
